_comment: Example plan file for `parallel-claude plan`. Each feature gets its own worktree + branch + Claude session. Keep `files` disjoint across features — the `check` step aborts on overlap unless --force.

features.name: paywall-copy
features.description: Rewrite paywall headline + CTA copy per 2026-10 marketing brief.
features.prompt: Replace the headline string with the one in docs/paywall-copy.md section 2. Update the CTA button to say 'Unlock PDF tools'. No other changes.

features.name: dashboard-empty-state
features.description: Add an illustrated empty state to the dashboard when the user has zero docs.
features.prompt: Build a new EmptyState component (text + illustration placeholder + CTA to upload) and wire it into DashboardShell when the docs query returns an empty list.

features.name: upload-progress-aria
features.description: Add aria-live region to the upload toast so screen readers announce progress.
features.prompt: Wrap the progress text in a role='status' aria-live='polite' container. Keep visual styling identical.
